weights: Each selected exact ligand-protein pair has unit weight in point estimates. Repeated measurements are collapsed to median pKd before membership assembly.
source_wide_spearman: Midrank Pearson correlation over all finite observed-predicted pairs.
within_target_centered_spearman: Within each eligible protein, subtract the unweighted target mean separately from observed and predicted pKd, pool centered values, then compute midrank Pearson correlation.
within_target_pairwise_concordance: For each eligible protein, evaluate all unordered ligand pairs; score direction agreement as 1, disagreement as 0, and any tie as 0.5; average within protein and then macro-average proteins.
attenuation: source_wide_spearman - within_target_centered_spearman in every point and bootstrap calculation.

bootstrap.algorithm: Sample observed document components with replacement; represent draws by component multiplicities and retain all selected rows in each sampled component.
bootstrap.interval: Studentized max-t simultaneous 95-percent interval across the four primary models for each endpoint; percentile fallback only when a standard error is zero or nonfinite.
bootstrap.endpoint_adjustment: Holm-adjust two-sided bootstrap sign p-values across the four primary endpoints within each model.

secondary_analysis: MAE and interval diagnostics versus the frozen constant reference
target-level top-decile enrichment and best-ligand regret
strict publication-time subset and exact-10000-nM exclusion
missingness: No post-outcome row removal. Abstentions are reported by model; each endpoint uses all finite nonabstained rows for that frozen model.
software_rule: The analysis script SHA-256, protocol SHA-256, implementation-spec SHA-256, source assembler SHA-256, representation generator SHA-256, and prediction script SHA-256 must be frozen before prediction or outcome access.
rerun_rule: The real locked analysis is single-run. Integration and synthetic tests must use synthetic paths and complete before the real Stage 2 lock.
